# Suggest remediation actions for heteroscedasticity

<small>Source: [`R/remediation.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/remediation.R) · Help: `?suggestRemediation`</small>

Given diagnostic test results from `runHeteroTests()`, this helper
provides a basic summary of recommended follow-up steps. It evaluates the
number of significant tests and proposes variance stabilising
transformations or modelling approaches.

## Usage

```r
suggestRemediation(diagnostic_results)

## S3 method for class 'remediation_suggestions'
print(x, ...)
```

## Arguments

`diagnostic_results`
:   Named list of `htest` objects as returned by
    `runHeteroTests()`.

`x`
:   Object of class `remediation_suggestions`.

`...`
:   Not used.

## Value

An object of class `remediation_suggestions` containing a summary
of potential actions.

## Details

The function counts how many diagnostic tests yield a p-value below 0.05.
If none are significant it returns a brief conclusion that no action is
needed. Otherwise a severity level is assigned and appropriate
transformations or variance modelling approaches are suggested: a
transformation when White's test rejects, and variance modelling when the
Breusch-Pagan test (`"breusch_pagan"`) or Koenker's studentized form of it
(`"koenker"`, in the default battery of [`runHeteroTests()`](runHeteroTests.md) since 0.15.0)
rejects.

## Examples

```r
data(mtcars)
mod <- lm(mpg ~ wt + qsec, data = mtcars)
res <- runHeteroTests(mod, mtcars)
suggestRemediation(res)
```
